## Validation Checklist
- [ ] Tests were run (if applicable)
- [ ] Typecheck passed (`pnpm typecheck` / `npm run build`)
- [ ] Lint passed (`pnpm lint` / `npm run lint`)
- [ ] No secrets were introduced (e.g. no .env committed)
- [ ] Environment variables were handled safely (added to `.env.example` if needed)
- [ ] Authentication/authorization was considered
- [ ] Database changes include appropriate migrations
- [ ] Breaking changes are documented
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes were reviewed
